capture.method: Manual pause and selection in the first clean dancer sequence after the concentric-pattern background; saved with Cmd+S while paused. Not a deterministic frame-number replay.
actions: Cold boot the named disk with the recorded configuration.
Watch past the Spaceballs introduction into the first dancer sequence.
Cmd+P pauses; unpause briefly and pause again to select the raised-arm pose.
Cmd+S saves the raw full frame, excluding the pause and notification overlays.
capture.post: Copied unchanged: full frame, no crop, rescale, recolouring or overlays.
